acceptance_criteria: A fresh executor starts only from the target repository root README at the pinned checkpoint plus this capsule and the exact promoted shared workflow binding.
Project-local course/source/assignment/mastery/artifact authority remains in the target repository; workspace-control contributes reusable mechanics only.
Any shared-contract adoption is explicit and pins an exact compatible workspace-control checkpoint; no moving-main dependency is introduced.
Existing active project work is not silently migrated merely because the shared architecture is newer.
Legacy conversational builder/tutor dependencies are removed only if the target actually has them and durable repository owners replace them.

The existing workspace-control.lock.json compatibility pin is changed only through an explicit validated transition.
Assessment preparation keeps factual authority separate from contextual assessment relevance and does not impose a fixed prior-exam ranking.
Current Exam/course material and durable mastery state remain authoritative and are not rewritten by the architecture migration.
constraints: Do not mutate workspace-control shared architecture from this child; its workflow binding is read-only.
Do not rewrite authoritative instructor/course content merely to fit the new shared architecture.
Do not alter unrelated branches, assignments, research repositories, archived capsules, or external submission state.
Do not silently rebase/reset/overwrite if the target branch moved after the pinned starting checkpoint; refresh durable task state first.
Follow the operator continuation obligation and use runtime only when project-specific validation actually requires it.
Do not treat the child migration as authorization to alter the content of an in-progress assessment-preparation task.
